purpose: Create the Dataset-owned internal command that safely forms multi-evidence candidate state from an authorized follow-up Outcome without coupling it to Task & Follow-Up wiring or granting lifecycle/trainability authority.
success_outcome: AssociateFollowUpEvidenceCommandV1 derives matching photo/check-in/measurement candidates only from the locked Outcome's authorized refs, rechecks current scope and candidate versions, enriches only candidate|needs_review with one typed follow_up_outcome ref, derives follow_up_seen, increments version, appends one redacted event per changed row, makes identical delivery a no-op, and leaves lifecycle/quality/split/confirmation/curator/trainability unchanged.
anti_goals: TaskFollowUpService wiring, caller-selected candidate IDs, arbitrary evidence, lifecycle transitions, Curator execution, HTTP/UI, batch/backfill, or terminal candidate mutation.
evidence_required: FT-014-AC-007 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: TASK-048 intentionally has no evidence-association application command, so the exact command claim cannot be invoked before implementation; alternative proof: preflight one-ref canonical candidate plus GREEN target-derivation/append/no-op/forbidden-field matrix; decisive comparison: exact refs, follow_up_seen, version, unchanged authority fields and event count; artifact: focused PostgreSQL transcript under .tasks/TASK-049-T3-FT-014-W3/.
constraints: The command receives a locked Outcome row and authorized canonical refs from its caller; plant and plant_state_record refs yield no candidate match.
Confirmed/rejected/excluded candidates stay unchanged; zero eligible matches succeeds without an event.
No database lock is held outside this command transaction and no Timeline event grants replay authority.
invariants: Evidence association never transitions a candidate or sets can_train_on.
Only same-Farm/Plant source identity may determine a target candidate; callers cannot name one.
verification_targets: FT-014-AC-007: PostgreSQL matrix for each supported/ignored source kind, current scope/lock order, stale/concurrent/archive/revoke cases, candidate-state eligibility, idempotent duplicate, exact changed/unchanged result, event cardinality/redaction, append rollback and commit-failure noise.
